description.en: Creates an animal (or other creature) model from the file data/chr/model/rpg/npc/caNNNNm.xc: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(3, _charaName, file, "dmy", _shadow). Unless _no_bustup is true, it also creates a bust-up picture with CMND_CREATE_BUSTUP(handle, name + "顔", true, _npc_no).
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
Number NNNN of the model file caNNNNm.xc.
true to skip the bust-up picture.
true to give the model a shadow.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: An animal with its bust-up (real usage, from ev42042400.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
